name: Nimbus Pro Wireless Earphones
tagline: True wireless sound that keeps up with your day.
description: The Nimbus Pro pairs a deep, balanced bass with crisp highs, wrapped in a featherlight in-ear shell. With 28 hours of combined playback and a quick 10-minute top-up for 2 hours of listening, it's built for commutes, calls and everything between.
specs: Touch controls with voice assistant support

name: Meridian Classic Chronograph Watch
tagline: A timeless face for boardrooms and evenings out.
description: Precision-engineered with a sapphire-coated crystal face and a stainless steel case, the Meridian Classic brings old-world craftsmanship to your wrist. The chronograph dial and genuine leather strap make it as suited to formalwear as it is to a Sunday brunch.

name: Velvet Oud Eau de Parfum
tagline: A warm, woody signature that lingers just right.
description: Velvet Oud opens with notes of amber and saffron before settling into a smoky base of oud wood and musk. Long-lasting and versatile, it's designed for everyday wear that still feels a little special.
specs: Base notes: oud wood, musk, sandalwood

name: Bloom Body Care Gift Set
tagline: A little self-care, boxed up and ready to gift.
description: This set brings together a body lotion, shower gel and a fragrance mist in a soft floral scent, packed in reusable glass bottles. A thoughtful pick for birthdays, housewarmings, or just because.
specs: Includes lotion, shower gel & mist (250ml each)

name: Aria Smartwatch - Classic Black
tagline: A minimalist dial with everything you actually use.
description: Aria Classic Black keeps things simple: a clean round face, always-on display option, and the health tracking basics done well. Pair it once and it quietly stays out of your way.
specs: 7-day battery life on a single charge
Heart rate, SpO2 and sleep tracking

name: Aria Smartwatch - Fitness Edition
tagline: Built for the days that start before sunrise.
description: The Fitness Edition adds 20+ workout modes, built-in GPS and a tougher case to the Aria lineup. It tracks the runs, the swims and the recovery days equally well.
specs: Built-in GPS for pace and distance

name: Aria Smartwatch - Sport Band
tagline: Lightweight, colourful, and ready for anything.
description: The Sport Band trades formality for comfort — a soft silicone strap and a lighter case that barely registers on your wrist, even after a full day of wear.

name: Aria Smartwatch - Minimal Steel
tagline: The Aria for people who don't want it to look like a gadget.
description: A brushed steel bezel and a slimmer profile make the Minimal Steel read more like a watch than a wearable, without giving up step counts, notifications or heart rate tracking.
